scope: New Game story background video and the Ai-chan guide's two closed-mouth idle portraits (cat, catgirl), used as separate layers: video, transparent portrait, DOM text and music. Not the title, logo or NS33 title film.

ownerApproval.statement: Owner approved this layered v3 story and Ai-chan guide version, and authorised Claude to complete paging and interaction; the package's own candidate/pending labels predate that approval.

source.intakeRecord: Local archive onboarding-ai-chan-owner-approved-20261103 (handoff/ASSETS_READY_FOR_INTEGRATION_ZH_TW.md, evidence/LAYERED_ZIP_INTAKE.json); ZIP CRC and path safety verified before extraction.

conversion: None. Every file is the package's own bytes, copied unchanged (no re-encoding of the WebP portraits or the MP4).

files.portraitFraming: Same video, centre-framed (object-fit cover) on portrait screens; whole 16:9 frame (contain) on landscape and desktop. No separate 9:16 file was supplied in this package.

files.anchor: Top-aligned half-body window, width : height = 1 : 0.815 (timeline.json); window ends at source row 584, above the paws. Face window cx 380, cy 215, size 300.
Same window, image raised 14% of the window height (timeline.json catgirlImageTop); ends at source row 586, at the hips. Face window cx 318, cy 212, size 230.

notIncluded: The 34-expression WebP pack, PNG masters and the separate 9:16 background were not in this package and are not referenced.
acceptance: Local Chromium normal-flow QA only (390x844, 844x390, 1366x768). Physical-device, iOS Safari and human listening acceptance are pending.
